auditResults.testName: Order creation and persistence
auditResults.action: Submitted checkout for 1 item with COD payment method
auditResults.actual: Created order VEL-2026-00047 with status "pending", payment_status "pending", total ₹4349
auditResults.expected: Order created with status 'pending', payment_status 'pending', matching line items

auditResults.testName: Inventory stock deduction
auditResults.action: Checked stock quantity for variant d1111111-1111-4111-d111-000000000006
auditResults.actual: Initial stock: 4, New stock: 3 (decremented by 1)
auditResults.expected: Stock decremented by ordered quantity to 3

auditResults.testName: Order confirmation email dispatch
auditResults.action: Inspected transactional email dispatch log for COD order
auditResults.actual: Email logged with subject "Order Confirmed: VEL-2026-00047 - Velaash"
auditResults.expected: Confirmation email dispatched to audit.cod.1790920209914@example.com

auditResults.testName: Razorpay order creation with real test keys
auditResults.action: Created online payment order via createOrderAction
auditResults.actual: Created Velaash order VEL-2026-00048 with real Razorpay Order ID "order_TivjsgHU9LnEjp" (425000 paise)
auditResults.expected: Real Razorpay Order ID created via https://api.razorpay.com/v1/orders starting with 'order_'

auditResults.testName: Server-side Razorpay payment lookup guard returns PAYMENT_PENDING_WEBHOOK when unindexed
auditResults.action: Called verifyRazorpayPaymentAction with valid HMAC signature before Razorpay index completion
auditResults.actual: Success: false, code: "PAYMENT_PENDING_WEBHOOK", error: "Your payment is being confirmed by your bank. Please do not refresh — this page will automatically update in a few seconds."
auditResults.expected: Returns code 'PAYMENT_PENDING_WEBHOOK' with friendly bank confirmation copy

auditResults.testName: Inventory stock reservation for online order
auditResults.action: Checked stock quantity after online order creation
auditResults.actual: Stock before online order: 3, New stock: 2
auditResults.expected: Stock decremented by 1 to 2

auditResults.testName: Authoritative webhook payment.captured confirms order & records payment
auditResults.action: Processed signed payment.captured webhook notification
auditResults.actual: Webhook status: "order_confirmed", DB order status: "confirmed", payment_status: "paid", payment_id: "pay_test_1790920212272"
auditResults.expected: Order status transitioned to 'confirmed', payment_status 'paid', payment ID recorded

auditResults.testName: Webhook payment.captured idempotency on duplicate delivery
auditResults.action: Delivered duplicate payment.captured webhook event for already-confirmed order
auditResults.actual: HTTP 200, returned: {"received":true,"event":"payment.captured","status":"duplicate_skipped"}
auditResults.expected: HTTP 200, status 'duplicate_skipped' (graceful idempotent handling)

auditResults.testName: Attempt to order quantity exceeding stock
auditResults.action: Attempted to order quantity 12 when available stock is 2
auditResults.actual: Blocked with error: ""Chanderi Embroidered Kurta Set" has only 2 available in stock (you requested 12)." (Code: OUT_OF_STOCK)
auditResults.expected: Rejected with code 'OUT_OF_STOCK' and exact available stock count in message

auditResults.testName: Two concurrent orders competing for last unit (No overselling race condition)
auditResults.action: Fired 2 parallel checkout requests concurrently against a variant with exactly 1 unit left
auditResults.actual: Order 1 success: true, Order 2 success: false, Rejection: "An item in your cart is no longer available in the requested quantity. Please update your cart." (Code: OUT_OF_STOCK), Final remaining stock: 0
auditResults.expected: Exactly one order succeeds, the other is rejected with 'OUT_OF_STOCK', stock drops to 0 (never negative)

auditResults.testName: Customer closes modal & retries payment (Reuses existing order, no duplicate)
auditResults.action: Submitted checkout, simulated modal dismissal, then re-submitted same checkout payload
auditResults.actual: First order: VEL-2026-00051, Retry order: VEL-2026-00051, isDuplicate flag: true
auditResults.expected: Returns the identical order number and Razorpay order ID without creating a new order row

auditResults.testName: payment.failed webhook maintains order in recoverable 'pending' state
auditResults.action: Dispatched payment.failed webhook to /api/webhooks/razorpay
auditResults.actual: Order status: "pending", payment_status: "pending", history logs: 2
auditResults.expected: Order remains 'pending' (recoverable), failure reason logged in order_status_history

auditResults.testName: Payment Failed email dispatched with retry URL
auditResults.action: Checked transactional email log for Payment Failed notification
auditResults.actual: Dispatched with subject "Payment Notice: Order VEL-2026-00051 - Velaash" to "audit.retry.1790920216580@example.com"
auditResults.expected: Payment Failed email dispatched with clear reference and retry link

auditResults.testName: Invalid / non-existent coupon code rejection
auditResults.action: Validated non-existent coupon code 'NONEXISTENT_PROMO'
auditResults.actual: Rejected with message: "Coupon "NONEXISTENT_PROMO" does not exist. Please check the code and try again."
auditResults.expected: Rejected with clear invalid coupon message

auditResults.testName: WELCOME400 coupon discount amount verification
auditResults.action: Applied WELCOME400 coupon to ₹4,250 order subtotal
auditResults.actual: Discount applied: ₹400 (Coupon record has discountValue: 400, announcement bar advertises: "₹400 Off")
auditResults.expected: Discount applied should be ₹400 to match the advertised promotional copy

auditResults.testName: Invalid pincode format rejection ('000000')
auditResults.action: Submitted checkout with invalid Indian pincode '000000'
auditResults.actual: Blocked with error: "Please enter a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code (e.g. 560001)" (Code: INVALID_INPUT)
auditResults.expected: Blocked with code 'INVALID_INPUT' (6-digit Indian PIN starting with 1-9 required)

auditResults.testName: Invalid phone number format rejection ('12345')
auditResults.action: Submitted checkout with 5-digit phone number '12345'
auditResults.actual: Blocked with error: "Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number (e.g. 9876543210)" (Code: INVALID_INPUT)
auditResults.expected: Blocked with code 'INVALID_INPUT' (Valid 10-digit Indian mobile required)

auditResults.testName: COD maximum order value (₹20,000 limit) enforcement
auditResults.action: Submitted COD order totaling ₹25,500 exceeding COD limit ₹20,000
auditResults.actual: Blocked with error: "Cash on Delivery is not available for orders above ₹20,000." (Code: COD_UNAVAILABLE)
auditResults.expected: Blocked with code 'COD_UNAVAILABLE' and clear message stating maximum limit ₹20,000

auditResults.testName: COD rate limiting blocks rapid repeated submissions (>3 orders/24h)
auditResults.action: Attempted 4 rapid COD checks with phone '9999900001'
auditResults.actual: Attempt 1: true, Attempt 2: true, Attempt 3: true, Attempt 4 (Exceeded): allowed=false, error="Too many Cash on Delivery orders from this number recently — please try online payment or contact us on WhatsApp"
auditResults.expected: First 3 attempts allowed; 4th attempt blocked with rate limit error message

auditResults.testName: Abandoned online pending order expires after 30 mins and releases stock
auditResults.action: Created online pending order, aged timestamp to 45m ago, invoked cancelExpiredPendingOnlineOrders(30)
auditResults.actual: Order status: "cancelled", Stock before reservation: 2, during reservation: 1, after reaper: 2
auditResults.expected: Order status transitioned to 'cancelled', soft-reserved stock restored to catalog

auditResults.testName: OrderConfirmationEmail template renders without broken variables or missing styles
auditResults.action: Rendered OrderConfirmationEmail component to full HTML string
auditResults.actual: Rendered 8816 bytes, broken placeholders: None, brand colors present: true
auditResults.expected: Zero undefined/NaN/broken placeholders, valid luxury brand styling

auditResults.testName: PaymentFailedEmail template renders with working retry link and support contact
auditResults.action: Rendered PaymentFailedEmail component to full HTML string
auditResults.actual: Rendered 6437 bytes, contains retry URL: true, broken tags: None
auditResults.expected: Contains valid retry link, accurate order number, and store contact

auditResults.testName: Order confirmation page resolves full details with valid access token (COD)

auditResults.testName: Order confirmation page resolves full details & paid status (Razorpay)
